edges.reason: msg.sender is copied into payee and drives the withdrawal credit lookup.
msg.sender identifies the attacking player and victim of virus debit.
msg.sender determines which player balance is drained in withdrawReward.
administrator is assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor.
block.timestamp (now) gates attack cooldown and is embedded in the emitted event.
block.timestamp (now) is used as entropy inside randomNumber.
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender in the disableContract guard.
withdrawPayments performs an external ETH transfer to the payee.
withdrawReward sends ETH to msg.sender before zeroing share and win.
upgrade executes selfdestruct(addr) without a two-step or timelock safeguard.
startNewBoss computes bossHp with a raw unchecked multiplication.
randomNumber increments randNonce with a raw unchecked addition.
randomNumber derives its output from predictable timestamp entropy.
startNewBoss makes an external claimPrizePool call to the engineer contract.
atkBoss enforces and stores cooldowns using block.timestamp.
atkBoss calls MiningwarContract.addCrystal, an external contract.
atkBoss calls EngineerContract.subVirus, an external contract.
startGame is gated by the isAdministrator modifier on msg.sender.
upgrade requires msg.sender to equal administrator.
setDefenceBoss is admin-restricted via msg.sender.
setBossHPDefault is admin-restricted via msg.sender.
setHalfTimeAtkBoss is admin-restricted via msg.sender.
disableContract modifier applies the tx.origin check to atkBoss.
disableContract modifier applies the tx.origin check to withdrawReward.
The raw send to msg.sender can re-enter withdrawReward before p.win and p.share are reset.
The ETH transfer to payee can re-enter withdrawPayments while state is mid-update.
The external addCrystal call can re-enter atkBoss before player state is settled.
The external subVirus call can re-enter atkBoss mid-execution.
The external claimPrizePool call can re-enter startNewBoss before boss data is written.
The _value parameter flows into virus, damage and event computation in atkBoss.
Local payee becomes the recipient of the external transfer.
Local payment is the amount forwarded in the external transfer.
dest parameter indexes payments in asyncSend.
amount parameter increments payments and totalPayments in asyncSend.
ethBonus is added to the last-hitting player's win in endAtkBoss.
Local reward is the value passed to the raw send.
_addr selects the PlayerData read in calculateShareETH.
_bossRoundNumber selects the BossData read in calculateShareETH.
_amount is multiplied by 5 and divided by 100 in devFee.
_addr is packed into the random seed in randomNumber.
_maxNumber is the modulus applied to the random hash.
_addr is forwarded to EngineerContract.calculateCurrentVirus.
addr parameter becomes the selfdestruct beneficiary.

normalization_plan.reason: Local payee only exists to feed the external transfer unsafe operation.
Local payment is the transfer amount for the same external call.
atkBoss parameter _value is only meaningful within that function's attack computation.
currentVirus local is an intermediate read used solely by atkBoss.
rate local is a temporary multiplier scoped to atkBoss.
atk local is a transient computed attack value inside atkBoss.
dame local tracks computed damage only within atkBoss.
crystalsBonus local is passed to the MiningwarContract call inside atkBoss.
isLastHit local is only used to decide and emit the boss-ending branch in atkBoss.
dest parameter is used exclusively by asyncSend.
amount parameter is used exclusively by asyncSend.
ethBonus local is computed and awarded only inside endAtkBoss.
Local reward is the value sent out by the unsafe raw send in withdrawReward.
_addr parameter is only used to look up players in calculateShareETH.
_bossRoundNumber parameter is only used to look up bossData in calculateShareETH.
_amount parameter is only used by devFee.
_addr parameter is only mixed into randomNumber's seed.
_maxNumber parameter only bounds randomNumber's output.
_addr parameter is only forwarded to the engineer contract in getEngineerCurrentVirus.
addr parameter is only consumed by the selfdestruct unsafe operation in upgrade.
